mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (0.08%) is at a historically low level, signaling an accommodative monetary policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% within the last 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1.0% and the CPI index is above 225.0, the real interest rate is low, signaling an accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 225.0.

mechanism_narrative: In the low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 5.0%), labor market tightness supports corporate earnings growth and reduces risk aversion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, labor market tightness supports corporate earnings growth and reduces risk aversion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 700.0 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100.0 (2017=100), it signals strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 700.0 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100.0, it signals strong economic activity and consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 700.0 AND INDPRO > 100.0.
